Custom Wine Boxes: Made for Luxury & Practicality

Good wine packaging can transform an inexpensive bottle of vino into something that looks and feels luxurious. Just as a good bottle of vintage can last for years, your brand will stay on top of customers’ minds with beautiful custom printed wine boxes.

While these wine shippers provide additional protection for bottles during transit, they alone will not prevent breakage and we recommend use of additional padding during shipment. 

Show Customers Your Good Taste

The right wine packaging will accentuate the design of the wine bottle. Additionally, it also serves as protection against breakage. Choose from these two wine gift box styles, which can comfortably fit a bottle of cabernet:

One Bottle
Box Length: 12.625”
Box Width: 3.437”
Box Depth: 3.437”
Material Thickness: B-Flute (1/8")

Two-Bottle
Box Length: 12.625”
Box Width: 6.89”
Box Depth: 3.437”
Material Thickness: B-Flute (1/8")

Printed wine boxes made of durable corrugated cardboard that securely holds wine bottles. The wine cartons have a roll end tuck front closure to keep the box securely closed. 

  • Standard White Corrugated Cardboard – This box material has a white base that makes printed colors appear vibrant. It has an uncoated surface, which is perfect for writing the recipient’s name or adding personalized
  • Kraft (Brown) Corrugated Cardboard – The natural finish of this box lends a rustic appeal to organic wine products. Note that the ink colors may not appear as saturated on this material.

 

UPrinting’s custom wine boxes come with packaging inserts (not printable), white insert for Standard and Premium White boxes and kraft (brown) insert for Kraft boxes. These inserts help keep the wine bottles compact and intact inside the box during shipping or when the customer carries them from your store to their homes.

Want to add special features like spot UV, window cut-outs, foil stamping, perforation, and more? Send us an email and our packaging specialist will assist you.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What size bottle does it fit?

Our boxes are designed to fit standard 750mL wine bottles measuring approx. 11.8" (30 cm) in length with a diameter of approx. 2.95" (7.5 cm).

Q: Can I print on the box insert?

Wine box inserts are not printable. You'll receive a standard white insert for both Standard and Premium White boxes and kraft (brown) insert for Kraft boxes.

Q: Can I order a Wine Mailer Boxes with custom dimensions, or specialized inserts?

Of course! Our packaging specialists would be happy to help you create a box that meets your specific needs. Reach out to us via email at boxes@uprinting.com.

Q: What’s the difference between standard white and premium white corrugated cardboard?

The standard white corrugated cardboard is uncoated and has a dull, somewhat uneven white tone. The premium white corrugated cardboard has a slight sheen and looks whiter.

Q: Can I order a sample piece?

Yes, you can order just one box, so you can check the quality, size, material, and print before placing a bigger order.

Q: How will you ship the boxes, do they require assembly?

The wine boxes will be shipped flat to save space, with the boxes and inserts separated. The exterior box will assemble similar to our Mailer Boxes, then you fold the place the insert inside.
